<thought>Using the valid functional group names, we search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that breaks a ketone and a C‑C double bond and forms an aliphatic hydroxyl and a five‑membered ring, which matches the carbonyl‑ene transformation described. This will give us the template ID(s) that can be applied to the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C= C(c1ccccc1)C1CCC(C(F)(F)F)(O)1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C double bonds"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic hydroxyls", "five-membered rings"],
    "bonds_formed": null,
    "bonds_broken": null,
    "bonds_order_changed": null,
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
